body.p: Prior to a formal examination of the above-identified application, acceptance of the above-recited amendments is respectfully requested.
Applicant has amended the abstract to shorten the abstract for conformity with U.S. Patent and Trademark Office practice. Applicant respectfully submits that the amendments do not add any new matter.

Applicant has submitted one sheet of replacement drawings. The replacement sheet of drawings does not involve substantive changes, but rather relates to the renumbering of the drawings originally filed with the application. Applicant therefore submits that the drawings do not contain any new matter.
If the Examiner has any questions or concerns, the Examiner is invited to contact the Applicant's undersigned attorney.
